familyIntro: Three generations caring for our vines and wines
wineryText1:
Over the years, our desire to share our wine with more people grew stronger and stronger.

So in 2022 we made a bold decision – to turn our favourite pastime into something more and create our own family winery.

We knew the road would not be short. We decided to build the winery with our own hands and our own means, step by step, with a lot of hard work, patience and perseverance.

We started by searching for and buying the right place for the future winery. Then came the design, the preparation for construction and countless small and big decisions.

At the same time, we kept expanding our knowledge and skills in winemaking. Our curiosity and eagerness to learn took us to university, where Bilyana completed a Master's degree in Wine Technology. This was another important step towards our dream – to have a qualified oenologist in the family and to combine tradition and hands-on experience with professional knowledge when making our wines.

Ladzhovi Winery is our way of continuing the family tradition while adding our own ideas, knowledge and dreams to it.

We are building it in the belief that good wine deserves time, care and a personal touch – just like the winery itself.

We want our wines to reach not only our family and friends, but everyone who appreciates wine made with dedication and respect for tradition.

Wine that holds a piece of our story, respect for our roots and faith in the future.
vineyardText1:
Our vineyards are located in the village of Vinogradets, Pazardzhik Province – an area with long-standing traditions in vine growing and winemaking.

In our family vineyard we grow Merlot, Cabernet Sauvignon and Syrah – the three varieties behind the distinctive blend of our young red wine.

In 2025 we took another step forward by buying a second small vineyard with Merlot and Mavrud.

We love to experiment, discover new combinations and challenge our own skills. At the same time, we keep our respect for the traditional winemaking methods that have proven their worth over the years.

For us, every harvest is a new opportunity to learn something, try something different and create a wine we would happily serve at our own table.
historyText1:
We are Bilyana and Atanas Ladzhovi.

Red wine has been made in our family for more than 30 years. The tradition was started by Grandpa Nasko, who passed on to us his love for the vineyard and taught us to tend it with patience and perseverance.

In 2016, side by side with our parents, we continued caring for the family vineyard and keeping up the tradition of making our own red wine.

Over time, vine growing and winemaking quietly became our favourite pastime. Every year brings new challenges, new lessons and new reasons to keep improving.

To this day, there is no greater pleasure than a sip of wine made from grapes we have grown ourselves. And when we share the fruits of our labour with family and friends, we won't hide that we feel quite a bit of pride!
